InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: Represents a warehouse stock item with SKU, rack location, pricing, and quantity.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated warehouse owner.

sku.description: Unique product code or SKU (e.g., BRG-001).

category.description: Warehouse product category (e.g., Elektronik, Bahan Baku, Kemasan).

locationRack.description: Warehouse shelf/zone location (e.g., Zona A - Rak 02).

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g., Pcs, Box, Kg, Karton, Pallet).

notes.description: Additional warehouse notes or storage instructions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when item was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when item was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

StockMovement.title: StockMovement
StockMovement.description: Immutable record of an inbound, outbound, or opname stock movement.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who recorded the movement.

itemName.description: Denormalized product name at the time of transaction.

itemSku.description: Denormalized SKU code at the time of transaction.

type.description: Type of stock movement: IN (Barang Masuk), OUT (Barang Keluar), ADJUST (Stok Opname).

quantityChanged.description: Absolute quantity added, removed, or adjusted.

referenceDoc.description: Reference document number (e.g., PO-2026-01, SJ-2026-08, OPN-01).

partyName.description: Supplier name (for IN), recipient/customer (for OUT), or auditor (for ADJUST).

notes.description: Notes or reason for the stock movement.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when movement was logged (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/items/{itemId}.description: Warehouse inventory items scoped per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/movements/{movementId}.description: Warehouse stock movement history (inbound, outbound, opname) scoped per authenticated user.
